To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) latent skill planning can be used to learn reusable skills in a sample efficient way; (ii) latent skill planning is particularly well suited for transfer learning; (iii) latent skill planning enables fast adaptation to new tasks at test time.
we introduce a novel approach for learning skills in reinforcement learning, and show that it improves sample efficiency and transfer performance in challenging locomotion tasks.

1) Latent Skill Planning (LSP) outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on locomotion tasks in terms of sample efficiency and 2) LSP achieves state-of-the-art performance in terms of transfer performance from one task to the next, as well as in terms of zero-shot transfer.
